sections.sectionName: Unit 1: How can we eat well?

vocabularies.definition: A soft yellow food made from cream, used for spreading on bread or cooking.
vocabularies.example:
She spread butter on her toast.
Keep the butter in the fridge.
Do you cook with butter or oil?
quizzes: I spread yellow __________ on my bread for breakfast.
Please put the __________ back in the fridge.
She used fresh __________ to bake a cake.

vocabularies.definition: A mineral essential for healthy teeth and strong bones.
vocabularies.example:
Milk is rich in calcium.
Children need calcium to grow strong bones.
Yogurt is a good source of calcium.
quizzes: Drinking milk provides __________ for strong bones.
Cheese and leafy greens contain lots of __________.
__________ helps keep your teeth healthy.

vocabularies.definition: Substances in foods like bread and rice that supply your body with energy.
vocabularies.example:
Pasta is rich in carbohydrates.
Athletes eat carbohydrates before a race.
Carbohydrates give us energy to run.
quizzes: Bread and rice contain high amounts of __________.
Eating __________ gives you energy for sports.
Potatoes are a main source of __________.

vocabularies.definition: Foods made from milk, such as cheese, butter, and yogurt.
vocabularies.example:
Cheese and milk belong to the dairy family.
Store dairy products in the refrigerator.
Some people avoid dairy foods.
quizzes: Milk and yogurt are examples of __________ products.
Store all __________ items in a cold fridge.
He cannot eat __________ due to allergies.

vocabularies.definition: A nutrient in food that provides stored energy and protects organs.
vocabularies.example:
Nuts contain healthy fat.
Limit unhealthy fat in your diet.
Your body needs a small amount of fat.
quizzes: Avocados contain healthy __________.
Avoid eating too much unhealthy __________.
Healthy __________ protects internal organs.

vocabularies.definition: Part of plant food that aids digestion and keeps the gut healthy.
vocabularies.example:
Apples contain plenty of fiber.
Fiber helps your digestive system.
Whole grains are high in fiber.
quizzes: Fruits and vegetables are full of __________.
Eating __________ helps your digestion.
Oats provide plenty of dietary __________.

vocabularies.definition: A mineral needed by red blood cells to carry oxygen throughout the body.
vocabularies.example:
Spinach contains lots of iron.
Iron helps carry oxygen in your blood.
Feeling tired can mean low iron.
quizzes: Spinach provides essential __________ for your blood.
Your red blood cells need __________ to carry oxygen.
Red meat is a good source of __________.

vocabularies.definition: Inorganic nutrients like iron and calcium needed for good health.
vocabularies.example:
Vegetables are rich in vitamins and minerals.
Water provides essential minerals.
Eat a balanced diet to get minerals.
quizzes: Our bodies need vitamins and __________.
Calcium and iron are two essential __________.
Spring water contains healthy natural __________.

vocabularies.definition: A liquid fat obtained from plants or seeds used in cooking.
vocabularies.example:
Pour olive oil into the skillet.
Cooking oil helps fry vegetables.
Keep oil stored in a cool place.
quizzes: Pour a spoonful of olive __________ into the pan.
We use vegetable __________ for frying.
Salad dressing often contains olive __________.

vocabularies.definition: A nutrient found in meat, eggs, and beans that builds muscle.
vocabularies.example:
Chicken is packed with protein.
Protein builds and repairs muscle tissue.
Beans provide plant-based protein.
quizzes: Eggs and fish are high in __________.
Muscle repair requires adequate __________.
Tofu is a rich source of plant __________.

vocabularies.definition: Plants used as food, such as carrots, spinach, and broccoli.
vocabularies.example:
Eat fresh vegetables daily.
Broccoli is my favorite vegetable.
Wash vegetables before cooking.
quizzes: Fresh green __________ are full of nutrients.
Carrots and spinach are healthy __________.
Always wash your __________ thoroughly.

vocabularies.definition: Natural substances in food required for health and growth.
vocabularies.example:
Oranges have Vitamin C.
Vitamins protect you from illness.
Fruits provide natural vitamins.
quizzes: Citrus fruits contain essential __________.
Eating fresh fruit supplies your body with __________.
Carrots provide valuable __________ for eyes.

vocabularies.definition: Meat from a cow.
vocabularies.example:
My mom cooked beef stew.
Grilled beef steak is delicious.
We bought beef at the market.
quizzes: We had grilled __________ for dinner.
Pho soup is made with tender __________.
Buy fresh __________ from the butcher.

vocabularies.definition: Cooked in boiling hot water.
vocabularies.example:
I ate a boiled egg for breakfast.
Boiled vegetables are healthy.
She served boiled chicken.
quizzes: I prefer a __________ egg in the morning.
__________ potatoes are light and healthy.
Serve __________ carrots with the meal.

vocabularies.definition: A small individual piece of baked bread.
vocabularies.example:
He ate a warm bread roll.
Cut the bread roll in half.
The basket was full of bread rolls.
quizzes: The waiter brought a warm __________ __________.
I sliced the soft __________ __________ to make a sandwich.
A crusty __________ __________ goes well with soup.

vocabularies.definition: A green vegetable with a thick stem and flower head.
vocabularies.example:
Broccoli is rich in fiber.
Steamed broccoli tastes great.
He eats broccoli with cheese.
quizzes: Green __________ looks like tiny trees.
Steamed __________ makes a healthy side dish.
Roast the __________ with olive oil.

vocabularies.definition: Cooked in hot oil.
vocabularies.example:
Fried rice is very tasty.
Don't eat too much fried food.
She made fried chicken.
quizzes: We ordered crispy __________ chicken.
__________ rice is easy to prepare.
Avoid eating deep-__________ food daily.

vocabularies.definition: Cooked on a grid over heat.
vocabularies.example:
Grilled fish is healthy.
We cooked grilled sausages.
Grilled chicken smells great.
quizzes: We enjoyed __________ salmon for lunch.
Dad made __________ chicken on the barbecue.
Serve the __________ meat with fresh salad.

vocabularies.definition: A sweet, clear gelatin dessert that wobbles.
vocabularies.example:
Kids love fruit jelly.
Red jelly wobbles on the plate.
She made orange jelly.
quizzes: The sweet fruit __________ wobbled on the spoon.
Children enjoy eating cold __________ in summer.
Serve strawberry __________ with fruit.

vocabularies.definition: A Japanese soup made from fermented soybean paste.
vocabularies.example:
Miso soup is warm and light.
Sushi is often served with miso soup.
Miso soup contains tofu and seaweed.
quizzes: We started dinner with hot __________ __________.
__________ __________ contains tofu and seaweed.
A bowl of __________ __________ is very comforting.

vocabularies.definition: Long thin strips of pasta or rice flour dough.
vocabularies.example:
He ate chicken noodles.
Vietnamese noodles are delicious.
Boil noodles for five minutes.
quizzes: She ate a warm bowl of egg __________.
Vietnamese pho __________ are world famous.
Boil the __________ until tender.

vocabularies.definition: Beaten eggs folded around cheese or vegetables.
vocabularies.example:
She made a cheese omelet.
An omelet is fast to cook.
Add vegetables to your omelet.
quizzes: He ordered a mushroom __________ for breakfast.
Fold the __________ over the cheese filling.
Cooking an __________ takes only a few minutes.

vocabularies.definition: Thin flat round cakes fried on a pan.
vocabularies.example:
We made pancakes on Sunday.
Pour maple syrup on pancakes.
Stack pancakes on a plate.
quizzes: Pour sweet syrup over warm __________.
Making fluffy __________ is fun.
Top your __________ with fresh berries.

vocabularies.definition: A large fish with pink flesh rich in omega-3.
vocabularies.example:
Salmon is a healthy fish.
Grilled salmon tastes sweet.
Salmon swim up rivers to lay eggs.
quizzes: Fresh __________ is rich in healthy fish oil.
Grilled salmon with lemon is delicious.
Pink __________ is popular in sushi.

vocabularies.definition: A diet with proper proportions of all main nutrient groups.
vocabularies.example:
A balanced diet keeps you fit.
Combine proteins and greens for a balanced diet.
Healthy growth requires a balanced diet.
quizzes: Maintain a __________ __________ for good health.
A __________ __________ includes fruit, vegetables, and protein.
Eating a __________ __________ gives you daily energy.

vocabularies.meaning: người hảo ngọt / thói quen thích ăn đồ ngọt
vocabularies.definition: A strong preference for sweet-tasting foods.
vocabularies.example:
She has a sweet tooth for chocolate.
Satisfy your sweet tooth with fruit.
He has a sweet tooth and loves cake.
quizzes: He buys ice cream because of his __________ __________.
If you have a __________ __________, eat apples instead of candy.
Her __________ __________ makes her love desserts.

vocabularies.definition: The amount of food or water consumed per day.
vocabularies.example:
Watch your daily intake of sugar.
Drink water for your daily intake.
The daily intake of calories depends on activity.
quizzes: Monitor your __________ __________ of calories.
Ensure your __________ __________ of water is sufficient.
Check the recommended __________ __________ on food labels.

vocabularies.definition: Damage to teeth caused by bacteria and excess sugar.
vocabularies.example:
Brush teeth to stop tooth decay.
Sugar causes tooth decay.
The dentist treated my tooth decay.
quizzes: Avoid candy to prevent __________ __________.
Brush twice daily to stop __________ __________.
The dentist checked my teeth for __________ __________.

vocabularies.definition: A medical condition where blood sugar levels are too high.
vocabularies.example:
Exercise helps control diabetes.
Less sugar lowers diabetes risk.
My grandpa manages his diabetes well.
quizzes: People with __________ watch their sugar intake.
A healthy lifestyle reduces the risk of __________.
Limiting sweet drinks prevents __________.

vocabularies.definition: A quick increase in strength or alertness.
vocabularies.example:
A banana gives a boost of energy.
Water provides a quick boost of energy.
Get a boost of energy from a short break.
quizzes: Eating fruit gives a quick __________ __________ __________.
Exercise gives you an immediate __________ __________ __________.

vocabularies.definition: To perceive odors using your nose.
vocabularies.example:
The soup smells good.
Smell the flowers in the garden.
This cheese has a strong smell.
quizzes: Fresh bread __________s wonderful.
Can you __________ the flowers in the air?
The soup began to __________ delicious.

vocabularies.definition: To direct your eyes toward something or appear a certain way.
vocabularies.example:
The cake looks delicious.
Look at the bright colors.
You look energetic today.
quizzes: The salad __________s fresh and colorful.
__________ at the rainbow in the sky!
She __________s happy after her meal.

vocabularies.definition: To sense flavor in your mouth.
vocabularies.example:
Lemons taste sour.
Taste the soup to check seasoning.
This pie tastes very sweet.
quizzes: This honey __________s sweet.
Please __________ the soup to see if it needs salt.
Ripe berries __________ fresh and juicy.

grammars.structure: Động từ chỉ giác quan (Sensory verbs)
grammars.description: Các động từ smell, look, taste (có mùi, trông có vẻ, có vị) được dùng để mô tả cảm nhận. Thường đi kèm với tính từ hoặc dùng cấu trúc smell / look / taste + like + Danh từ để so sánh.
grammars.example:
It smells delicious and looks good.
It tastes like beef, but it looks like chicken.

grammars.structure: Cấu trúc Will / Won't cho quyết định tức thời
grammars.description: Dùng will hoặc phủ định là won't để diễn tả một quyết định được đưa ra ngay tại thời điểm nói (quick decisions).
grammars.example:
I'll look in the Indian restaurant.
I won't drink soda every day.

sections.sectionName: Unit 2: Why are some buildings famous?

vocabularies.definition: A person who designs buildings and oversees their construction.
vocabularies.example:
The architect designed a modern museum.
She wants to become a famous architect.
The architect drew the blue prints.
quizzes: The famous __________ designed this incredible skyscraper.
She hired an __________ to design her new home.
An __________ plans how buildings will look.

vocabularies.definition: To draw interest, attention, or visitors to a place.
vocabularies.example:
The Eiffel Tower attracts millions of tourists.
Bright colors attract beautiful butterflies.
The monument attracts visitors worldwide.
quizzes: The magnificent castle __________s thousands of tourists each year.
Bright lights __________ night insects.
Historical sites __________ history lovers.

vocabularies.definition: A structure built to span physical obstacles such as a body of water or road.
vocabularies.example:
We crossed the long bridge over the river.
The Golden Gate Bridge is famous.
Engineers built a strong steel bridge.
quizzes: Cars drove slowly across the tall suspension __________.
We walked across the wooden __________ to cross the stream.
The city built a new __________ over the bay.

vocabularies.definition: A hard building material made from gravel, sand, cement, and water.
vocabularies.example:
The foundation was made of solid concrete.
Concrete is strong and durable.
Workers poured wet concrete.
quizzes: The walls of the fortress were made of thick __________.
Mix cement and gravel to make strong __________.
Heavy trucks drove over the fresh __________.

vocabularies.meaning: sự xây dựng / công trình xây dựng
vocabularies.definition: The process of building something large like a tower or bridge.
vocabularies.example:
The bridge construction took three years.
Wear a hard hat near construction sites.
Road construction delayed the traffic.
quizzes: The __________ of the new skyscraper started last month.
Workers wear helmets on the __________ site.
Heavy machinery was used during tower __________.

vocabularies.definition: Exceptionally large, heavy, and solid.
vocabularies.example:
The ancient pyramid is a massive stone structure.
A massive wall surrounds the city.
The elephant moved its massive body.
quizzes: The cathedral features a __________ stone dome.
We stared up at the __________ mountain peak.
A __________ crowd gathered near the monument.

vocabularies.definition: Units of length in the metric system equal to 100 centimeters.
vocabularies.example:
The tower stands 300 meters high.
The bridge stretches for 500 meters.
How many meters tall is the building?
quizzes: The monument reaches a height of 150 __________.
We swam fifty __________ across the pool.
The fence measures two __________ tall.

vocabularies.definition: Relating to present or recent times; using recent style or technology.
vocabularies.example:
The city has many modern glass buildings.
Modern architects use steel and glass.
I prefer modern designs.
quizzes: The museum features a sleek, __________ design.
Smartphones are an important part of __________ life.
She loves living in a __________ apartment building.

vocabularies.definition: A statue or building erected to commemorate a person or event.
vocabularies.example:
The Washington Monument honors a president.
Tourists visited the national monument.
The ancient stone monument stands on the hill.
quizzes: People gathered at the memorial __________ to pay respect.
The marble __________ stands in the town center.
This historic __________ was built centuries ago.

vocabularies.definition: A carved or cast figure of a person or animal.
vocabularies.example:
The Statue of Liberty stands in New York.
A bronze statue was placed in the square.
The artist sculpted a stone statue.
quizzes: The bronze __________ of the king stands in the park.
Visitors took photos of the famous marble __________.
The sculptor carved a beautiful lion __________.

vocabularies.meaning: kết cấu / công trình kiến trúc
vocabularies.definition: A building or object constructed from several parts.
vocabularies.example:
The Eiffel Tower is an impressive structure.
Engineers tested the wooden structure.
The ancient stone structure remains standing.
quizzes: The bridge is a remarkably strong steel __________.
Architects planned every detail of the building's __________.
The wooden __________ survived the thunderstorm.

vocabularies.definition: A tall narrow building or part of a building.
vocabularies.example:
The clock tower strikes at midnight.
You can see the city from top of the tower.
The TV tower is very tall.
quizzes: We climbed to the top of the bell __________.
The city skyline is dominated by a glass __________.
Look at the high watch __________ on the hill.

vocabularies.definition: Curved structures supporting the weight of an opening or roof.
vocabularies.example:
Roman aqueducts feature beautiful stone arches.
The entrance was decorated with arches.
Arches add strength to bridges.
quizzes: The cathedral is famous for its grand stone __________.
Walking under the decorative __________ felt historic.
Engineers designed curved __________ to hold weight.

vocabularies.definition: The part of a bell tower or steeple in which bells are hung.
vocabularies.example:
The church bell rang high up in the belfry.
Pigeons nested in the old belfry.
We climbed the stairs to the belfry.
quizzes: The church bells chime loudly from the high __________.
Visitors peered into the historic wooden __________.
Bats flew out from the dark __________ at sunset.

vocabularies.definition: Small booklets containing pictures and information about a place.
vocabularies.example:
We picked up travel brochures at the hotel.
The brochure describes historic landmarks.
Read the brochure for tour details.
quizzes: The travel agent handed us colorful tourist __________.
Check the information inside the travel __________.
The museum offers free informative __________.

vocabularies.definition: To stay in a tent outdoors, or a site where tents are pitched.
vocabularies.example:
We plan to camp near the lake this weekend.
The summer camp offered fun outdoor games.
Set up the tent at our camp.
quizzes: We pitched our tent at the mountain __________ site.
They decided to __________ near the pine forest.
Night at the summer __________ was filled with stories.

vocabularies.definition: Cut or shaped into a shape or design out of hard material.
vocabularies.example:
The wooden door was beautifully carved.
Ancient statues were carved from marble.
He carved a bird from wood.
quizzes: The stone pillars were intricately __________ by artists.
She admired the __________ wooden figures.
The statue was __________ out of a single granite block.

vocabularies.meaning: công trình biểu tượng / địa danh
vocabularies.definition: An easily recognizable feature or building in a landscape.
vocabularies.example:
The Big Ben is a famous London landmark.
This tower is a landmark of our city.
The castle serves as a coastal landmark.
quizzes: The Opera House is an iconic national __________.
Tourists use the high tower as a navigational __________.
Paris has many world-famous historic __________s.

vocabularies.definition: Relating to the Middle Ages (from about 500 to 1500 AD).
vocabularies.example:
We visited a medieval castle with thick walls.
Knights lived in medieval times.
The town retains its medieval charm.
quizzes: The castle is a great example of __________ architecture.
Stories about knights take place in __________ times.
The museum displays metal armor from __________ Europe.

vocabularies.definition: Buildings occupied by a community of monks living under religious vows.
vocabularies.example:
Ancient monasteries stand quietly in the mountains.
Monks lived and studied in quiet monasteries.
We visited historic mountain monasteries.
quizzes: Silent monks lived peacefully inside the stone __________.
The mountain path leads up to ancient __________.
Many historical books were preserved in __________.

vocabularies.definition: A large painting executed directly on a wall or ceiling.
vocabularies.example:
The artist painted a vibrant mural on the building wall.
A historic mural decorates the hall.
Students created a mural for school.
quizzes: A colorful painted __________ covers the school wall.
The artist spent months completing the wall __________.
Visitors admired the historical story shown in the __________.

vocabularies.definition: A set of items wrapped together or an all-inclusive travel deal.
vocabularies.example:
They booked a holiday tour package.
The postman delivered a cardboard package.
This travel package includes meals.
quizzes: We booked a complete vacation tour __________ to Paris.
The courier delivered a small heavy __________.
The hotel offers an all-inclusive holiday __________.

vocabularies.definition: A set of stairs and its surrounding structure inside a building.
vocabularies.example:
We walked up the grand spiral staircase.
The wooden staircase leads upstairs.
Be careful descending the slippery staircase.
quizzes: She walked up the majestic marble __________.
A wooden __________ connects the first and second floors.
The old castle features a narrow spiral __________.

vocabularies.definition: Having the distinctive qualities of a particular type or group.
vocabularies.example:
Red tiles are typical for houses in this village.
It was a typical sunny afternoon.
A typical breakfast includes toast and tea.
quizzes: This wooden house shows __________ local architecture.
A __________ day begins with a warm breakfast.
The dish has a __________ sweet and sour flavor.

vocabularies.definition: The length of time that a building or person has existed.
vocabularies.example:
The age of this ancient temple is over 1000 years.
Determining the age of old ruins is tricky.
What is the age of this castle?
quizzes: Historians calculated the exact __________ of the ruins.
The castle shows signs of great __________.
Respect the old __________ of historic buildings.

vocabularies.definition: The appearance of things caused by light reflecting off them.
vocabularies.example:
The building is painted a vibrant blue color.
What color is the palace roof?
Bright color makes the landmark stand out.
quizzes: The golden __________ of the cathedral shone in the sun.
Choose a pastel __________ for the exterior walls.
The vibrant __________s of the mural drew a crowd.

vocabularies.definition: The measurement of someone or something from base to top.
vocabularies.example:
The height of the skyscraper is 400 meters.
He is afraid of great height.
Measure the height of the statue.
quizzes: The massive tower reaches a towering __________ of 300 meters.
She measured the __________ of the doorway.
The building's unusual __________ made it famous.

vocabularies.definition: A particular place or position.
vocabularies.example:
The hotel is in a prime beachfront location.
What is the location of the famous statue?
The map shows the monument location.
quizzes: The castle occupies a scenic mountain __________.
The GPS helped us find the exact __________ of the ruins.
This city central __________ is ideal for tourists.

vocabularies.definition: The matter or substance from which a thing is made.
vocabularies.example:
Wood and stone are traditional building material.
Concrete is a durable construction material.
What material is this statue made of?
quizzes: Granite is a durable __________ for building statues.
Architects select high-grade construction __________.
Glass is a popular transparent __________.

vocabularies.definition: The external form or outline of someone or something.
vocabularies.example:
The building has an unusual pyramid shape.
Draw the shape of the castle tower.
Geometric shapes make modern design.
quizzes: The roof has an interesting dome __________.
Cut the stones into a rectangular __________.
The tower features a sleek circular __________.

vocabularies.definition: The purpose for which something is employed or put into service.
vocabularies.example:
The original use of the building was a fortress.
What is the current use of this palace?
The hall is reserved for public use.
quizzes: The historic castle is now put to __________ as a museum.
This room is dedicated for public __________.
The original __________ of the tower was a lighthouse.

vocabularies.definition: Measuring a specified distance from bottom to top; high.
vocabularies.example:
He is a very tall man.
The skyscraper is extremely tall.
How tall is the clock tower?
quizzes: The city built a new, extremely __________ tower.
Look at those __________ oak trees in the forest.
The giraffes are the __________est animals.

vocabularies.definition: Measuring a great distance from end to end.
vocabularies.example:
The Great Wall of China is very long.
We took a long walk across the bridge.
How long is the hallway?
quizzes: The bridge stretches over a __________ river distance.
We took a __________ train journey through the valley.
She wore a __________ elegant dress to the party.

vocabularies.definition: Extending far down from the top or surface.
vocabularies.example:
The well is thirty meters deep.
They swam in the deep pool.
Don't go into deep water.
quizzes: The castle moat was very __________ and wide.
Ocean trenches are incredibly __________.
He dug a __________ hole to plant the tree.

vocabularies.definition: At, to, or by a great distance in space or time.
vocabularies.example:
The castle is far from the village.
How far is the airport from here?
They traveled far away.
quizzes: The historic ruins are __________ from the main city.
How __________ is the next gasoline station?
She traveled __________ across the ocean.

vocabularies.definition: Measuring a great distance from side to side.
vocabularies.example:
The avenue is broad and wide.
The river is half a mile wide.
Open the door wide.
quizzes: The main avenue is extremely __________.
The boat sailed across a __________ lake.
She opened her arms __________ for a hug.

vocabularies.definition: An instrument containing a magnetized pointer showing magnetic north.
vocabularies.example:
Use a compass to find direction in the woods.
The hiker checked his compass.
A compass needle points north.
quizzes: Always carry a __________ when hiking in unknown forests.
The sailor looked at his magnetic __________.
The needle of the __________ points towards the north.

vocabularies.definition: A battery-operated portable light.
vocabularies.example:
Shine the flashlight into the dark cave.
We used a flashlight when power failed.
Pack a flashlight for camping.
quizzes: Turn on your __________ when walking in the dark.
The camper packed extra batteries for his __________.
A bright __________ lit up the campsite.

vocabularies.definition: A cream or lotion used to protect skin from sunburn.
vocabularies.example:
Apply sunblock before going to the beach.
Sunblock protects your skin from UV rays.
Don't forget to pack sunblock.
quizzes: Put on plenty of __________ before swimming outdoors.
Using __________ prevents sunburn on sunny days.
Apply water-resistant __________ every two hours.

vocabularies.definition: A diagrammatic representation of an area of land or sea.
vocabularies.example:
Study the map to locate the historic monument.
We unfolded a paper city map.
Find our position on the map.
quizzes: We checked the tourist __________ to locate the famous bridge.
The map showed all major city landmarks.
Unfold the road __________ to choose our route.

grammars.structure: Hỏi đáp về kích thước và khoảng cách
grammars.description: Sử dụng từ để hỏi How kết hợp với tính từ (tall, long, deep, far) để hỏi về số đo hoặc khoảng cách.
grammars.example:
How tall is the Galata Tower? – It's 67 meters tall.
How far is Mexico City from New York? – It's 3,360 kilometers away.

grammars.structure: Tương lai gần (Be going to + verb)
grammars.description: Dùng cấu trúc going to + động từ nguyên thể để nói về các kế hoạch, dự định đã được đưa ra trước thời điểm nói (decisions taken before the time of speaking).
grammars.example:
I'm going to do a lot of different activities.
Are you going to study all day? – No, I'm not.

sections.sectionName: Unit 3: How can we protect wild animals?

vocabularies.definition: A large fast-swimming predatory ocean fish with blue v-shaped fins.

The bluefin tuna can swim very fast.

Complex protein molecule.

grammars.structure: Đại từ bất định (Indefinite Pronouns)
grammars.description: Kết hợp các tiền tố some-, every-, no-, any- với one, body, thing để nói về người hoặc vật một cách chung chung, không cụ thể (Ví dụ: someone, everybody, nothing, anything...).
grammars.example:
Everyone had fun at the party last night.
I went to the park, but there wasn't anybody there.

grammars.structure: Phân biệt Look like và Be like
grammars.description: Look like dùng để hỏi/miêu tả về đặc điểm ngoại hình thể chất (physical appearance); trong khi Be like dùng để hỏi/miêu tả về tính cách (personality).
grammars.example:
Who do you look like? – I look like my dad. We both have blond hair.
Who are you like? – I'm like my mom. We're both pretty stubborn.
